description: This file defines platform abstraction types and a default 'empty' platform implementation for the Playwright project, including platform-specific utilities, environment, and stream handling.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: A context for managing execution scope, data, and stack operations.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: An interface describing platform-specific functionalities and properties.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Push data onto the zone stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Pop data from the zone stack.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Execute a function within the zone context.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Retrieve data associated with the zone.
